preconditions.expression: all(3 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()) and all(3 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= min(int(n)*int(m), 100000) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: The first line contains three integers n, m, k where 3 ≤ n, m ≤ 1000 and 1 ≤ k ≤ min(n·m, 100000).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == int(n) + int(m) + int(k) + 1 and all(len(line) == int(m) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:int(n)+1])
preconditions.description: The museum grid has exactly n lines of m characters each, followed by k starting positions.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in ['.', '*'] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:int(n)+1] for cell in line)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the museum grid is either '.' (empty) or '*' (impassable).

preconditions.expression: all(line[0] == '*' and line[-1] == '*' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:int(n)+1]) and all(line[0] == '*' and line[-1] == '*' for line in [stdin.splitlines()[1], stdin.splitlines()[-int(n)]])
preconditions.description: All border cells of the museum grid are impassable ('*').

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= int(n) and 1 <= int(y) <= int(m) for line in stdin.splitlines()[int(n)+1:] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each starting position (x, y) is within the grid bounds (1 ≤ x ≤ n, 1 ≤ y ≤ m).

preconditions.expression: all(stdin.splitlines()[int(n)+i][j*2:(j+1)*2] == '.' for i in range(int(k)) for j in range(int(m)) if int(stdin.splitlines()[int(n)+i].split()[0]) == i+1 and int(stdin.splitlines()[int(n)+i].split()[1]) == j+1)
preconditions.description: All starting positions are in empty cells ('.').

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(max_pictures(x, y, grid)) for x, y, grid in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[int(n)+1:]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[int(n)+1:]], [stdin.splitlines()[1:int(n)+1]])]
postconditions.description: For each starting position (x, y), the output contains the maximum number of pictures Igor can see, where a picture is counted if Igor can reach a cell adjacent to a wall (a cell with a neighboring impassable cell '*').

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(num) <= 2 * (int(n) * int(m)) for num in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: Each output number is a non-negative integer representing the count of unique pictures Igor can see from reachable cells.
